breakfast.name: Apple Pie Smoothie
ingredients: 1 red delicious apple, cut into pieces
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse until smooth.

lunch.name: Seared Pork Chops with Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1 Green Bell Pepper De-seeded and cubed
steps: In a bowl thoroughly mix dry rub ingredients (cumin, mustard powder, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, 1 tablespoon salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper).Dust and massage dry rub into pork chops, rest in fridge for about 10min
Prep mango, bell pepper, onion, scallions, tomato, and cilantro set aside.
Heat pan w/ oil to med high, sear pork chops. 2-3 minutes on each side.
Let pork chops rest 5-8 minutes before serving.Take salsa bowl, add juice of a whole lime, add salt and pepper to taste.
Place pork chop on plate and top with mango salsa.

dinner.name: German Goulash
steps: Cut roast in 1 inch cubes. In Dutch oven, brown meat, and onions in oil.
Add water, bouillon cubes, flour, tomato sauce, paprika, and pepper. Simmer low for 2 hours, until meat is tender.
This dish cooks up very well in a crock pot.
